clusters.objective: Ensure the resident follows scheduled medication and related care/training routines, with escalating reminders when a dose or session is missed.
clusters.meaningful_failure: care_lapse (missed medication or missed cognitive-training session)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: implicit (field-deployed reminders and ambient cues accepted by resident); explicit notification/voice escalation in hypothetical rule
clusters.rationale: tareme_trial5_001 is rated strongly_implies by both coders with recurring scope, self beneficiary, care_lapse failure, accepted automation, and implicit authorization from a real field deployment; userneeds_u09_r051 (independent owner, second study cluster) converges on the medication-adherence facet with an explicit missed-dose escalation rule.
clusters.boundary_notes: Emotional-comfort facet of tareme_trial5_001 (pink lighting when sad) is split into emotional_comfort_and_rest_support per the conjunction-splitting rule; the two clusters share one anchor unit but address distinct maintained outcomes. Cognitive-training reminders have no second owner and ride on the tareme anchor only.
clusters.coding_disagreements: tareme: coders agree strongly_implies/recurring/self/care_lapse but phrase the candidate responsibility differently (luna: wellbeing+medication routines; kimi: adherence+training+comfort). u09_r051: luna event_conditioned/household vs kimi recurring/self; both compatible_only.

clusters.objective: Restore the resident's emotional comfort and rest through ambient adjustment (soft lighting, relaxing music) when distress or poor recovery is detected.
clusters.meaningful_failure: discomfort (unrelieved sadness or unrecovered state after poor sleep and elevated heart rate)
clusters.authorized_action_scope: implicit (deployed ambient lighting response in field trial); explicit in hypothetical rule
clusters.rationale: The tareme field deployment shows a resident spontaneously using colored lighting for sadness and reporting relaxation — an accepted, delegated, recurring comfort outcome rated strongly_implies by both coders; u27_r160 from a second owner and second study cluster independently requests the same ambient-comfort response to physiological signs of poor rest.
clusters.boundary_notes: Split from the medication/care cluster; kept separate because comfort restoration and dose adherence are not jointly managed or traded off in the evidence. Convergent support rests on a single hypothetical owner, hence medium confidence.
clusters.coding_disagreements: u27_r160: luna failure_meaning discomfort vs kimi unknown; kimi candidate_responsibility null, luna null — convergence inferred from outcome similarity, not from coder-proposed labels.

clusters.objective: Have the kitchen and oven ready at planned mealtimes by preheating the oven and preparing the dining environment ahead of scheduled or routine meals.
clusters.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (meal delayed because oven or dining space was not prepared in time)
clusters.rationale: Three independent demand owners author time- or routine-conditioned oven-preheat / dining-preparation rules converging on the same maintained outcome (meal starts on time in a prepared space), but all evidence is hypothetical and confined to one study cluster with no deployed or cross-study anchor.
clusters.boundary_notes: userneeds_u18_r108 is compound (warmth+light+oven); its comfort facet is assigned to evening_thermal_comfort and its cooking facet here — one unit informing two clusters. Not merged with evening_thermal_comfort because meal readiness and room warmth are separable outcomes with different triggers and failures.
clusters.coding_disagreements: u09_r054: luna beneficiary unknown/failure unknown vs kimi household/none. u27_r157: kimi proposes no candidate responsibility; luna null. All rules compatible_only on both sides.

clusters.objective: Help the resident wake and start the morning on schedule through alarms, opened shutters, coffee, and a prepared bathroom.
clusters.meaningful_failure: inconvenience (oversleeping or an unprepared morning routine)
clusters.rationale: Coherent maintained outcome across two independent owners, but below admission thresholds: only 2 of the required 3 owners for candidate status, all rules hypothetical compatible_only, single study cluster, no direct anchor.
clusters.boundary_notes: Bath preparation in u18_r107 is treated as part of the morning routine, not as bath-safety; bath_overflow_prevention (u27_r162) is a distinct safety concern kept separate. Retained as a documented local cluster in case cross-study evidence appears elsewhere.
clusters.coding_disagreements: u18_r103: luna failure_meaning security_failure vs kimi unknown; u09_r053: luna event_conditioned vs kimi recurring; luna proposes no candidate responsibilities for any of the three rules.

clusters.objective: Keep the home secured and idle (alarm armed, lights off, shutters closed) with occupant notified whenever the house is unoccupied.
clusters.meaningful_failure: security_failure (home left unalarmed or openly lit while empty)
clusters.rationale: Two independent owners converge on absence-triggered securing of the home, but the grouping is below threshold: 2 owners in one hypothetical study cluster, compatible_only ratings, no deployment anchor.
clusters.boundary_notes: u18_r104 also carries an energy-saving facet (lights off); kept with securing because shutters+lights on vacancy is primarily an idle/secure-home action. Not merged with the single-owner unwatched-TV energy rule.
clusters.coding_disagreements: u18_r104: luna beneficiary household/failure discomfort vs kimi unknown/unknown; u27_r158: coders agree on household/security_failure but both rate compatible_only.

clusters.objective: Keep occupied evening rooms warm and lit when temperature drops below the comfort threshold.
clusters.meaningful_failure: discomfort (cold, dark rooms during evening occupancy)
clusters.rationale: Internally coherent comfort outcome but supported by a single independence unit (one demand owner) in one hypothetical study cluster — below every admission threshold.
clusters.boundary_notes: u18_r108 is shared with meal_preparation_readiness (comfort facet here, cooking facet there). Kept distinct from emotional_comfort_and_rest_support: thermal comfort is condition-triggered room conditioning, not distress-responsive ambient care.
clusters.coding_disagreements: u18_r106: luna beneficiary unknown vs kimi unknown — agree on discomfort; u18_r108 minor beneficiary wording differences (luna self, kimi self) with compatible_only on both.

excluded_groups.reason: Single owner, single study cluster, compatible_only from both coders; hypothetical notification preference with no established recurrence, deployment, or failure meaning; one-shot convenience character.
